testing_and_automation.data_testid_convention: kebab-case, role-based, unique for every key action

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Source code files use JavaScript (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript (.tsx). Maintain standard JS component conventions.
2. Store properties data with realistic prices in Brazilian Real (R$ 300 to R$ 1500 per night) across Porto Seguro, Ilhéus, and Arraial d'Ajuda.

3. Build exact WhatsApp checkout integration that triggers `https://wa.me/5511981389572?text=...` with formatted property title, checkin/checkout dates, number of guests, applied weekly/first-booking discount, and final calculated total.
4. Ensure property detail modal includes real OpenStreetMap using `react-leaflet` or Leaflet JS with valid lat/long coordinates for Bahian beaches.
5. Every interactive element MUST carry `data-testid` attribute as specified in testing_and_automation section.
6. Include amenities icons using `lucide-react` (Air conditioning: Wind, TV: Tv, Stove: Flame, Fridge: Refrigerator/Box, Pool: Waves, Wifi: Wifi, Barbecue: Grill/Flame, Parking: Car).
7. Implement responsive filters for location, nightly price range (R$300-1500), and specific amenities.

8. Implement promo calculation logic: Weekly stay (7+ nights) grants special package discount (e.g. 7 nights originally R$1,500 discounted to R$1,000) and first reservation toggle applies an extra discount.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use dark colors as heavy flat backgrounds for rental listings. Use soft warm sand neutrals with vibrant terracotta accents.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism backdrop blurs.
Do NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`). Always target specific properties like `transition: color 0.2s, background-color 0.2s, transform 0.2s`.
Do NOT center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`). Keep natural left-aligned reading hierarchy.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💡, 🔮) for UI icons. Use Lucide React icons.
Ensure generous spacing: containers with borders MUST have padding on text content to avoid collision.
Use `sonner` for toast notifications when adding properties to wishlist or copying WhatsApp links.
